repriced every minute · all windows

The regime

puts amplify +$12.0B, 95th pct of 13 sessions at the Oct 14, 3:59 pm bar · attribution unchecked

Estimated dealer gamma (assumed sign) — it describes the next 30 to 60 minutes' range and the last half hour's momentum on negative days; never a level, and never the flip's side.

Assumes customers sold the calls and bought the puts, so dealers hold the other side — open interest does not say who did.
